description: Synthetic week-3 slice for the evaluation harness: three study sessions (D13-D15), two notes, two assessment attempts (one finalized through an operator approval, one left provisional) and four competency observations. Invented content; no real names, no secrets, no real hosts.

competencies.name: Network path diagnosis
competencies.description: Locate a broken hop with ping, traceroute and the routing table, then restore reachability.

competencies.name: Linux service triage
competencies.description: Recover a failed service unit from its journal entries and unit file.

assessments.title: Week 3 network path practical
assessments.task_statement: Restore reachability from the lab workstation to the isolated service subnet and document the faulty hop.

assessments.title: Week 3 service triage transfer check
assessments.task_statement: Bring the stopped lab web service back and explain the journal entry that identified the cause.

notes.title: Reading the routing table
notes.body_markdown: The default route pointed at the decommissioned gateway. `ip route` listed it first; traceroute stopped at hop 2. Replaced the route and re-ran the reachability check.

notes.title: Week 3 reflection
notes.body_markdown: Hints were needed for the first route fault; the second one was solved unaided. Next week: read journal output before restarting units.
